analyst_view.overall: Early view: a mid-table game between ninth and tenth, one point apart. Famalicão have picked up under Ricardo Silva, who replaced the sacked Carlos Carvalhal in October and won three of his first four games; A Bola reports he is set to get the job permanently. Moreirense are under Vasco Botelho da Costa, now the league's longest-serving coach, and play at Alverca on Monday 7 December, so they have six days to recover.
